name: Sweet Lake Biscuits (Draper, UT) "The Hoss" Biscuit Sandwich (Heavy Fat Warning)
whyItWorks: A massive, decadent stack: fried chicken breast, bacon, fried egg, and cheddar smothered in sausage country gravy. The extreme grease and heavy cream trigger gallbladder spasms and rapid diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during active IBD. Order a plain biscuit with scrambled eggs and sliced avocado instead.
watchOuts: Fried chicken batter, bacon fat, and sausage gravy combine into an extreme GI trigger
